title: Cain kills Abel; "They hated Me without a cause" (Genesis 4:8; John 15:25)
summary: Genesis 4:8 (Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him) is set above John 15:25, where Jesus says this happened to fulfil the word written in their law, "They hated Me without a cause."

text.text: 8 And Cain talked with Abel his brother; and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
25 But this happened that the word might be fulfilled which is written in their law, ‘They hated Me without a cause.’
